title: Cowrite project config
description: The whole `.emend/config.json` file (FR-SKILL-5, tech-design §3.1): the published, repo-owned override for the `skills/` module's ratified discovery defaults — which directories are walked for `SKILL.md`, and where the workflow glob looks. Read once at project open (`skills::discover`); a missing, unreadable, or malformed file degrades to the ratified defaults rather than failing project open (FR-X-5). Every path this file names is confined to the project root before use (§3.5) — a value that escapes is rejected, not followed.

schema_version.description: Format revision, independent of this schema document's own `schema_version` above (TD-4: every Cowrite on-disk file carries one).

skills.description: Overrides FR-SKILL-5's skill-discovery default (any `SKILL.md` anywhere in the project tree, standard ignore dirs excluded).

roots.description: Project-relative directories to walk for `SKILL.md` instead of the whole project tree. Each entry is still subject to the same standard-ignore-dir exclusions and §3.5 confinement as the default walk; an entry that escapes the project root is rejected (dropped), not followed — the rest of the list, if any, still applies.

glob.description: A `<project-relative-dir>/*.md` glob replacing the default `workflows/*.md`. Only a single top-level directory plus a literal `*.md` suffix is supported — the ratified default itself is non-recursive (see `skills` module doc), so the override widens *where* it looks, not *how deep*; a broader glob grammar (recursion, multiple extensions) is a future schema_version, not this one. The directory portion is confined to the project root (§3.5) the same way `skills.roots` entries are; an escaping value is rejected, not followed.
